name: HearthBuilders
summary:
**A world to build in.** Every block can be broken and placed. Build houses and towers, farms and gardens, rails and machines that light up. Grassy plains, snowy mountains, deserts, jungles and deep caves wait to be explored.

 **A story that guides, never pushes.** Pip floats over your shoulder, shows the way when you want it, and cheers you on. Eleven chapters lead from your first shelter to the Ember Deep and the islands at the edge of the world, and the sandbox stays open the whole time. Turn the story
